name: Hangzhou Heatwell Electric Heating Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Heatwell Electric Heating Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of electric heating elements and assemblies in China and internationally. The company offers household and commercial appliance electric heating elements for use in kitchen appliances, clothing care appliances, HVAC systems, bathroom appliances, and cleaning appliances; industrial equipment electric heating elements for injection molding equipment, medical equipment, semiconductor equipment, energy storage, and special equipment.
